title: Model performance, threshold trade-offs, and calibration
purpose: Calculates ROC AUC, Brier score, confusion-matrix measures across thresholds, calibration intercept and slope, and calibration bins.
input: `Predictions` sheet with actual outcome, predicted score, and optional subgroup.
outputs: Threshold-performance table, ROC curve, threshold trade-off chart, calibration plot, and calibration statistics.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
